author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

`TICLCandidateProducer` corrects the time of a charged candidate for the flight path of its track. When the track has no MTD time, the path length comes from a propagation of the track to a disk at the z of the trackster barycenter. The lambda that builds the disk expects a positive z and puts the disk on the side of the track (the same convention as `TICLUtils.h` and `SeedingRegionByTracks`). The call passed the signed z of the barycenter. For a track with eta < 0 the disk was therefore at +|z|, the propagation failed, and the time used the straight line from the origin to the barycenter. The positive endcap was not affected.

This PR passes |z|. Only the time of charged candidates in the negative endcap changes.

The HLT runs the same producer (`hltTiclCandidate`, with `useMTDTiming = False`), so the HLT candidate times in the negative endcap change in the same way. I did not measure the HLT.

#### PR validation:

PU200 TenTau (E 15 to 500 GeV), Run4 D127, 50 events, RECO of the same DIGI file with `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-04-0000` and with this PR (`RecoHGCal/TICL` does not change between that IB and master). Candidates compared object by object:

- 97567 candidates in both; the only difference is the time of 763 charged candidates at eta < 0. The four-momenta, the pdgIds and all the other candidates are identical, and so is `pfTICL`.
- Median time of the charged candidates with a time and no MTD time: eta < 0 goes from 0.082 to 0.060 ns; eta > 0 stays at 0.054 ns.

`scram b code-format` and `code-checks` change nothing. The package has no unit tests.
title: fix candidates time for tracks without mtd
